blockedIdentities.reason: Kentek's first-party site presents a Finnish importer and multi-brand industrial filtration supplier. It does not establish a distinct Kentek-manufactured product portfolio for the undifferentiated repository record.

Kiesel's first-party site describes a system partner and distributor for construction machinery from multiple manufacturers. The record does not identify a separate Kiesel-manufactured equipment portfolio with sufficient certainty.

The manufacturer product directory is available only over HTTP and the official HTTPS endpoint presents an invalid self-signed certificate. The international publication gate requires secure official evidence.
Kitagawa America and Kitagawa-NorthTech resolve to the same North American legal company and workholding portfolio. The existing Kitagawa-NorthTech profile is retained as the canonical identity.

profiles.officialName: KARL DEUTSCH Prüf- und Messgerätebau GmbH + Co KG
profiles.shortDescription: KARL DEUTSCH develops non-destructive testing instruments, inspection systems and sensors for industrial quality control.
fullDescription: KARL DEUTSCH's official product directory documents equipment for ultrasonic, magnetic-particle and penetrant testing together with coating-thickness measurement.
The portfolio includes ECHOGRAPH inspection systems, ECHOMETER thickness gauges, LEPTOSKOP coating instruments and associated probes, sensors and testing accessories.

profiles.shortDescription: KARL GEORG manufactures crane wheels, wheel assemblies and related components for material-handling systems.
fullDescription: KARL GEORG's official product material documents crane wheels and wheel assemblies for industrial lifting and handling applications.
The company supplies machined wheel components and application-specific assemblies supported by in-house engineering and production capabilities.

profiles.shortDescription: Karl Klein Ventilatorenbau manufactures industrial fans and blowers for process-air and ventilation duties.
fullDescription: Karl Klein's official product directory covers low-, medium- and high-pressure industrial fans for different air-handling requirements.
Its documented range also includes dust fans, boiler fans, cast fans, plug-in units and portable fan configurations.

profiles.shortDescription: Karmsund Maritime Group develops sealing products, portable valve actuation equipment and custom mechanical components for onshore and offshore operations.
fullDescription: Karmsund Maritime's official site presents the KaMOS product business as a developer of sealing and valve-maintenance solutions for onshore and offshore industries.
Its published materials cover ring-joint and kammprofile gaskets, test sealing tools, portable valve actuators and custom manufactured mechanical equipment.

profiles.shortDescription: Kastaş manufactures sealing elements for hydraulic, pneumatic and rotary-motion systems.
fullDescription: Kastaş's official site documents a sealing-technology manufacturer serving fluid-power and motion applications.
The published range includes rod and piston seals, wipers, guide rings, static seals, O-rings, rotary seals and application-specific sealing solutions.

profiles.shortDescription: KASTO develops metal sawing machines, automated storage systems and material-handling software for bars and sheet metal.
fullDescription: KASTO's official site documents sawing systems for metal stock together with automated storage and handling solutions.
The portfolio spans band and circular saws, bar and sheet-storage systems, handling equipment and software for coordinating material flow and warehouse processes.

profiles.shortDescription: Katronic develops clamp-on ultrasonic flowmeters for non-invasive measurement of liquids and gases in pipelines.
fullDescription: Katronic's official site documents portable, fixed-installation and compact ultrasonic flowmeters that measure through the pipe wall.
The KATflow range supports flow monitoring, energy measurement and process diagnostics without opening the pipeline.

profiles.shortDescription: Kaukan Industries manufactures industrial cooling and heat-exchange units for precision machine tools and production machinery.
fullDescription: Kaukan's official product brochure documents cooling equipment designed to control thermal growth in machine tools and industrial machinery.
The range includes oil and water coolers, cutting-fluid and grinding-fluid units, electrical-cabinet air-conditioning units and heat-pipe heat exchangers.

profiles.shortDescription: Kawasaki Heavy Industries develops transportation, energy, industrial machinery, robotic and precision-equipment systems.
fullDescription: Kawasaki Heavy Industries' official corporate site presents a diversified engineering group operating across mobility, energy and industrial equipment.
Its documented businesses include rail vehicles, aerospace systems, energy equipment, industrial robots, machinery and precision hydraulic technologies.

profiles.shortDescription: Kawasaki Precision Machinery develops hydraulic pumps, motors, valves, controllers and integrated fluid-power systems.
fullDescription: Kawasaki Heavy Industries' official divisional profile identifies Precision Machinery as its hydraulic and control-technology business.
The documented portfolio includes hydraulic pumps, motors, valves, machinery applications, marine systems and electro-hydraulic controllers.

profiles.shortDescription: KB Electronics is a Nidec drive-controls brand for variable-speed AC and DC motor applications.
fullDescription: Nidec's official KB Electronics history identifies the business as a manufacturer of adjustable-speed motor controls founded in 1967.
Its documented products include variable-frequency AC drives, DC motor controls, brushless DC drives, fan controls and application-specific drive configurations.

profiles.shortDescription: Koenig & Bauer develops printing presses, production systems and workflow technology for packaging, publication and industrial printing.
fullDescription: Koenig & Bauer's official history documents KBA as the company's former group brand before the return to the Koenig & Bauer name in 2017.
The current official portfolio includes sheetfed, digital, web, flexographic and special printing systems together with production software and service solutions.

profiles.shortDescription: Koenig & Bauer Coding develops industrial coding, marking and printing systems for production lines and packaging.
fullDescription: Official Koenig & Bauer Coding material identifies KBA-Metronic as the former company name of the coding-technology business founded in 1972.
Its documented solutions include continuous-inkjet, laser, thermal-inkjet, hot-stamp and thermal-transfer systems together with coding software.

profiles.shortDescription: KELCH develops tool presetting, measuring, shrinking and tool-management systems for machining operations.
fullDescription: KELCH's official product pages document equipment for preparing and measuring cutting tools outside the machine tool.
The portfolio includes tool presetters, shrinking devices, balancing systems, tool holders and digital tool-management solutions.

profiles.shortDescription: KELI Sensing develops load cells, force and pressure transducers, weighing indicators and industrial weighing systems.
fullDescription: KELI Sensing's official site documents sensing and weighing components for force, load and process measurement.
Its product range includes analogue and digital load cells, force and pressure transducers, weighing indicators, junction boxes, flowmeters and integrated weighing systems.

profiles.shortDescription: KELK develops sensors and measurement systems for rolling mills and other heavy industrial processes.
fullDescription: KELK's official site identifies a measurement-equipment manufacturer established in 1953 and focused on steel and aluminium rolling mills.
Its portfolio covers roll-force and tension load cells, strip and plate geometry gauges, velocity and length measurement, pressure and displacement transducers and hot-metal detection.

profiles.shortDescription: Kellenberger develops precision grinding, turning and milling machines with supporting automation solutions.
fullDescription: Kellenberger's official product directory documents machine tools for precision grinding and combined machining tasks.
Its range includes cylindrical and jig grinding machines, turning and milling platforms, machining centres and automation for workpiece handling.

profiles.shortDescription: KELVA develops contact and non-contact web-cleaning systems for continuous and sheet-fed production processes.
fullDescription: KELVA's official site documents industrial dust-removal equipment for moving webs and sheets in printing, converting, film, paper, glass and nonwoven processes.
The range includes contact and non-contact cleaner heads, antistatic equipment, filter and fan units, web-tension controls and fluid-management components.

profiles.shortDescription: KEM Küppers develops flowmeters and signal-conditioning electronics for liquids, gases and demanding process media.
fullDescription: KEM's official product site documents precision flow-measurement technologies for industrial processes.
The portfolio includes Coriolis, gear, turbine, helical-screw and microflow meters together with transducers, amplifiers and evaluation electronics.

profiles.shortDescription: KEMET is a YAGEO Group brand for capacitors, magnetic components, sensors and circuit-protection devices.
fullDescription: KEMET's official site documents an electronic-component portfolio within YAGEO Group.
Its range includes ceramic, tantalum, film and electrolytic capacitors, inductors, transformers, electromagnetic-compatibility components, sensors, piezoelectric devices and relays.

profiles.shortDescription: Kemix develops process equipment for mineral recovery, mixing and carbon-management duties in the mining industry.
fullDescription: Kemix's official corporate brochure documents engineered equipment for mineral-processing and metallurgical plants.
Its portfolio includes agitation and mixing systems, pump-cell technologies, carbon-regeneration kilns and associated process equipment.

profiles.shortDescription: Kemppi develops welding machines, torches, automation equipment and digital welding-management tools.
fullDescription: Kemppi's official product site documents equipment and software for manual, mechanized and automated arc welding.
The range includes MIG/MAG, TIG and MMA power sources, welding torches, wire feeders, extraction products, robotic solutions and welding-management software.

profiles.shortDescription: Kendrion Kuhnke develops automation controls, pneumatic systems, solenoids and actuators for industrial machinery.
fullDescription: Kendrion's official product material identifies Kuhnke automation technologies within the group's industrial portfolio.
The documented scope covers machine controllers, input/output systems, operator interfaces, pneumatic components, solenoids and electromagnetic actuators.

profiles.shortDescription: Keofitt develops hygienic sampling valves and sampling accessories for representative process-media collection.
fullDescription: Keofitt's official product directory documents sampling valves for hygienic and aseptic liquid-process applications.
The portfolio includes Sesame, Classic and Basix valve families together with sampling equipment, accessories and cleaning or sterilization configurations.

profiles.shortDescription: Kessler + Co. develops axles, wheel drives, gearboxes and electric drive systems for heavy mobile equipment.
fullDescription: Kessler + Co.'s official site documents drivetrain systems for construction machinery, material-handling vehicles and other heavy-duty applications.
The product scope includes drive and steering axles, planetary gearboxes, wheel drives, electric drive units and associated control software.

profiles.shortDescription: KettenWulf manufactures conveyor chains, drive chains, sprockets and engineered chain components for industrial plants.
fullDescription: KettenWulf's official site documents industrial chain production dating to 1925.
Its portfolio includes conveyor and drive chains, sprockets, bucket-elevator chains, escalator chains and application-specific chain systems for bulk handling and production equipment.

profiles.shortDescription: KEVAC manufactures industrial vacuum cleaners, central vacuum systems and pneumatic-conveying solutions.
fullDescription: KEVAC's official site identifies an industrial vacuum-equipment manufacturer established in 2007.
The range includes mobile industrial vacuums, wet and dry extraction units, certified filtration configurations, central cleaning systems and pneumatic conveying equipment.

profiles.shortDescription: Keystone is an Emerson valve brand for butterfly, check and slurry-control applications with manual and powered actuation.
fullDescription: Emerson's official brand page documents Keystone as a current final-control valve portfolio.
The range includes resilient-seated and high-performance butterfly valves, check valves, slurry-service designs and pneumatic or electric actuator packages.

profiles.shortDescription: KHD Humboldt Wedag develops process equipment, pyroprocessing systems and automation for cement production.
fullDescription: KHD's official product directory documents technologies for grinding, pyroprocessing and plant automation in cement manufacturing.
The portfolio includes roller presses, separators, mills, preheaters, calciners, rotary kilns, coolers and process-control systems.

profiles.shortDescription: Kiepe Electric develops conveyor monitoring, safety, control and sensor equipment for bulk-material and machine systems.
fullDescription: Kiepe Electric's official product directory documents safety and monitoring equipment for conveyor installations and industrial machines.
The portfolio includes emergency-stop switches, belt-monitoring devices, speed sensors, magnetic equipment, control stations, joysticks and collision-avoidance systems.

profiles.shortDescription: KIESELMANN manufactures hygienic valves, tank fittings and process components for liquid-processing plants.
fullDescription: KIESELMANN's official product site documents stainless-steel process components for hygienic production environments.
The portfolio includes butterfly, ball, single-seat, double-seat, control and sampling valves together with tank fittings, strainers, sight glasses and pigging components.

profiles.shortDescription: Kimo Instruments develops portable and fixed measurement equipment for air quality, HVAC and combustion analysis.
fullDescription: Kimo Instruments' official product brochure documents instruments for measuring pressure, airflow, temperature, humidity and combustion parameters.
The product scope includes handheld meters, transmitters, data loggers, probes, anemometers and combustion analysers for HVAC and industrial air-management work.

profiles.shortDescription: Kinetrol manufactures pneumatic rotary-vane actuators and associated valve-control equipment.
fullDescription: Kinetrol's official site documents compact pneumatic rotary actuators for quarter-turn and motion-control duties.
The range includes double-acting actuators, spring-return packs, positioners, limit-switch boxes, electro-pneumatic controls, dashpots and complementary electric actuators.

profiles.shortDescription: Kirchner und Tochter develops flowmeters and flow-monitoring instruments for liquids and gases.
fullDescription: Kirchner und Tochter's official site documents flow-measurement equipment produced in Germany since 1951.
The product portfolio includes variable-area, piston, flap, bypass and differential-pressure instruments for visual indication, monitoring and process measurement.

profiles.shortDescription: Kitagawa-NorthTech provides machine-tool workholding, rotary tables, cylinders and robotic gripping systems in North America.
fullDescription: Kitagawa's official documentation identifies Kitagawa-NorthTech as a North American group company for machine-tool and automation products.
The documented portfolio includes power chucks, hydraulic and pneumatic cylinders, NC rotary tables, vises, grippers and workholding accessories.

profiles.shortDescription: KITZ manufactures industrial valves, strainers and automated flow-control assemblies for fluid systems.
fullDescription: KITZ's official product material documents a broad valve portfolio for industrial and building-service applications.
The range includes gate, globe, check, ball and butterfly valves, strainers and automatic valve configurations in multiple materials and pressure classes.

profiles.shortDescription: Klaschka develops industrial sensors, encoders, switching devices and control components for automation and machine monitoring.
fullDescription: Klaschka's official site presents Klaschka Sensor & Motion Technologies as the current company identity succeeding Klaschka Industrieelektronik.
Its portfolio includes proximity and position sensors, pulse encoders, relays, safety switches, double-sheet and thickness sensors and automation controllers.

profiles.officialName: Klemsan Elektrik Elektronik San. ve Tic. A.Ş.
profiles.shortDescription: Klemsan develops terminal blocks, industrial relays, measurement devices and connectivity products for electrical automation.
fullDescription: Klemsan's official site documents products for industrial electrical connection, protection, control and communication.
Its portfolio includes terminal blocks, relays, Ethernet switches, energy-measurement devices, signal converters, cable-management components and automation accessories.

profiles.shortDescription: KLINGER develops industrial sealing, fluid-control and level-monitoring products for process plants.
fullDescription: KLINGER's official product directory documents engineered sealing and fluid-control technologies.
The portfolio includes compressed-fibre and graphite sealing sheets, gaskets, industrial valves, level gauges, expansion joints and metal hoses for demanding process applications.

profiles.shortDescription: Klixon is a Sensata Technologies brand for thermal protection and circuit-control devices used with motors and electrical equipment.
fullDescription: Sensata's official product material identifies Klixon within its motor-protection and power-protection portfolio.
The documented scope includes thermal motor protectors, overload devices and circuit breakers designed to interrupt electrical loads under abnormal temperature or current conditions.

profiles.shortDescription: KNECHT is a legacy MAHLE filtration brand associated with engine air, oil, fuel and cabin filter products.
fullDescription: MAHLE's official migration material documents the transition of KNECHT-branded filter products to the MAHLE brand.
The retained historical product scope covers air, oil, fuel and cabin filters used in engine, vehicle and maintenance applications.

profiles.shortDescription: KNF develops diaphragm pumps and pump systems for gases and liquids in industrial, laboratory and medical equipment.
fullDescription: KNF's official product directory documents oil-free and media-isolated pump technologies for gas and liquid handling.
The portfolio includes diaphragm gas pumps, diaphragm liquid pumps, swing-piston pumps, vacuum pumps and configurable laboratory pump systems.

profiles.officialName: Knick Elektronische Messgeräte GmbH & Co. KG
profiles.shortDescription: Knick develops industrial signal-conditioning, electrical-measurement and process-analytics instruments.
fullDescription: Knick's official site documents measurement and interface technology for industrial automation and process analysis.
Its portfolio includes isolation amplifiers, transmitters, indicators, portable meters and analytical systems for pH, ORP, conductivity and dissolved oxygen.

profiles.shortDescription: Knödler manufactures industrial gearboxes and application-specific drive systems for machinery and processing equipment.
fullDescription: Knödler's official product directory documents gearbox technologies for industrial power transmission.
The portfolio includes shaft-mounted and helical-bevel gearboxes, extruder gearboxes, plasticizing drives for injection-moulding machines and special multi-output gear units.

profiles.shortDescription: Knorr-Bremse develops braking, control and auxiliary systems for rail vehicles and commercial vehicles.
fullDescription: Knorr-Bremse's official business-divisions page documents two principal product areas: rail vehicle systems and commercial vehicle systems.

The portfolio includes pneumatic and electronic braking systems, doors, HVAC and coupling systems for rail vehicles, plus steering, compressors, air treatment and transmission-control equipment for trucks, buses and trailers.

profiles.parentCompany: Hangzhou Donghua Chain Group Co., Ltd.
profiles.shortDescription: KÖBO manufactures industrial conveyor, drive and leaf chains together with sprockets and engineered chain systems.
fullDescription: KÖBO's official history documents the 2004 formation of KÖBO-KTB and the later transition to the current KÖBO company name.
The official product material covers precision conveyor chains, drive chains, leaf chains, sprockets and custom chain systems for material handling and production equipment.
